info.title: Undercore platform — native client boundary
info.description: Existing session API, not a new token API. Covered: native authentication, configuration list/detail/rename/download and notifications. Billing, RBAC, referrals, admin, web-only VPN mutations, monitoring and webhooks remain documented in docs/platform; they are not part of this initial machine contract. Responses include X-Request-ID (req_ plus 26 uppercase ULID characters). Platform ignores caller-selected IDs; VPN facades accept a single valid ID only after server authentication. Optional correlation metadata, never a credential or idempotency key. JSON DTO and command schemas unchanged.

post.description: Owner-scoped opt-in pilot. Verified active owner only. Atomically reserves one existing package slot; stable deviceKey is persisted before request and retries reuse it. Expiry and node cannot be chosen by client. Poll config detail until canDownload; no secret in response. Private no-store. Removed identity remains a tombstone. Session mutations require X-CSRF-TOKEN; Accept: application/json.

protocol.description: TrustTunnel requires an explicitly enabled pilot account; use a distinct persisted deviceKey for its test slot.

post.description: Opt-in AWG lab only. Session + CSRF + verified owner + current entitlement. Backend supplies canonical device identity, remote connection and expiry. Secret-bearing JSON, private no-store; never log/store. AWG v1 only currently; unsupported capabilities 422. No creation, renewal or legacy fallback. Revision belongs to this connection, not the legacy download revision. Session mutations require X-CSRF-TOKEN; Accept: application/json.

Explicit owner-scoped recovery opt-in. Same entitlement/security as manifest. At most one switch for an observed revision; retries resume it. Revoke before create, 30 minute durable cooldown. Client cannot choose node or expiry. Secret response, no-store. Session mutations require X-CSRF-TOKEN; Accept: application/json.
